sections.title: A truck, a toolbox *and a pager*
body: After his time in the Navy, Pat Quill wanted to build a business that would provide for his family and leave a legacy. In 1995 he started Carolina HVAC with a Mitsubishi Mighty Max truck, a plastic toolbox and a pager on his hip, running it from a folding table in the home office.

As soon as Pat's son Kyle graduated high school, he joined his dad's team as an install helper and worked his way through the trades. After more than 20 years side by side they became partners, and Kyle has led the company as President since 2023. Our values haven't changed: honoring God, quality craftsmanship and serving with integrity.

items.q: How long does an HVAC system last?
items.a: Most systems last 10 to 20 years. As equipment ages it loses efficiency, gets noisier and needs repairs more often. At that point you can keep repairing it or replace it, and we'll give you an honest recommendation either way.

items.q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
items.a: Yes. We install and repair commercial heating, air conditioning and electrical systems.
Aiken, Williston, Blackville, North Augusta, Barnwell, Jackson, New Ellenton, Wagener, Lexington and many more communities across Aiken, Barnwell and Lexington counties, plus Augusta, GA.
